cause.note: A reviewer launched at Phase 1 returned a full design verdict that had nowhere to land: the design gate opens at Phase 2. The session cost a complete Codex review and the ledger said only 'agent replacement paused'.

refuse: reviewer launch refused: the run is at Phase 1 and there is no design gate to receive a verdict; advance to Phase 2 first (or launch with --amendment for an open amendment)
